The bytes are sniffed, not trusted from the header: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF and SVG by their magic, 400 for anything else or anything over the limit. Written to /var/lib/losos/background.img before the document, so a crash between the two leaves the old picture, never a dangling reference. Each upload bumps `version`, which the SPA puts in the URL so a browser cache never shows the previous picture.

GET /api/look/background.in: query string: v=<version> (ignored by lososd; a cache key for the browser)
GET /api/look/background.out: the picture's bytes with its sniffed Content-Type, nosniff, Cache-Control private + immutable; 404 when there is none
GET /api/look/background.note: The one route under /api that takes no Bearer, on purpose: the page paints the picture through CSS (`background-image: url(...)`), and a CSS fetch carries no header. The route sits behind the same LAN-only nginx guard as the SPA, and a wallpaper is not a secret. Nothing else should join it here.

POST /api/look/widgets.in: {"id": "w<N>" (optional: rewrite that one), "name": "...", "span": "half|full", "files": [{"name": "index.html", "content": "..."}, ...] (or "source": "...", read as index.html)}
POST /api/look/widgets.note: Write or rewrite a widget by hand. The files are kept verbatim and never run by lososd or by the admin page: the board embeds it in `<iframe sandbox="allow-scripts" src="/widget-frame/">`, an opaque origin with no token and no API, which gets the files and the box's readings over postMessage and puts the linked ones in place (modules/containers.nix carries the frame's own CSP). 400 for a missing name, a name over limits.nameChars, no index.html or an empty one, a file name that is not lowercase letters, digits, - and _ with one of limits.fileKinds or is over limits.fileNameChars, a name used twice, more than limits.files files or limits.widgetBytes bytes together, more than limits.widgets widgets, or an id the box does not have. A new id is w<next>, never a reused one, so a board tile pointing at a deleted widget stays pointing at nothing.

DELETE /api/look/widgets/{id}.note: Idempotent; false when there was no such widget.

GET /api/hidden.note: This box's addresses on Tor and I2P (backend/plugins/hidden): `box` those its own Tor and I2P made for its front door (losos.hidden.tor.enable, losos.hidden.i2p.enable, read from /var/lib/losos-hidden/addresses.json), `edge` those the edge it heartbeats to made for it (losos.edge.hidden.*, /var/lib/losos-hidden/edge.json). A name is null while its network is off or its daemon has not made it yet, and when it does not have the shape of one. Section network.

GET /api/pins.note: What the owner pinned to the sidebar, in their order, kept on the box as /var/lib/losos/pins.json (backend/src/pins.rs). A pin is a reference, never an address: {"kind":"tile","app":"<an Overview tile id>"}, {"kind":"app","release":"<an app installed from the search>"}, {"kind":"file","id":<LosOS Cloud file id>,"path":"/...","folder":bool} or {"kind":"repo","owner":"...","name":"..."}. The SPA decides where each opens, always on this box (admin-ui/app/src/lib/pins.ts).

PUT /api/pins.note: Replace the list whole; a move is a PUT in the new order. 400 with the reason for more than `limit` pins, the same pin twice, an unknown kind or field, a tile id that is not lowercase letters, a release name that is not one, a file id of 0, a path that is not absolute or has an empty, . or .. part, or a repository name with anything but letters, digits, - _ and dots. Audited; not a rebuild.

GET /api/cloud/files.in: query string: path=/<folder> (default /), or q=<text> (1-100 characters) to search names anywhere
GET /api/cloud/files.note: One folder of the owner's LosOS Cloud, folders first then by name, at most 500 entries (`more` when there were more); with q, the files and folders whose name holds the text, at most 50. Asked over LosOS Cloud's socket (/run/losos-cloud/http.sock), which only root and nginx can open, naming the owner. 400 for a path or query that is not one, or a folder that is gone; 503 while LosOS Cloud is not answering.

GET /api/git/repos.in: query string: q=<text> (optional) to keep those whose name or description holds it
GET /api/git/repos.note: The owner's repositories on LosOS Git, private ones included, at most 50, by name. Asked as the bot administrator the configuration repository uses. `noGit` on a box without LosOS Git.

GET /api/site.note: The settings of LosOS Cloud and LosOS Git only (backend/src/site.rs): GET /api/options cut down to losos.cloud.trashDays and losos.git.site.*, with `stray` empty. Section apps, so a company edge the owner lets manage the box reaches it too.

POST /api/site.note: Set each named option to its literal, or back to its default with null. Each name must be one of GET /api/site's options and each literal must fit its editor kind on one line; anything else is 400 with a sentence naming the key, and nothing is written. Only those lines of overrides.nix change, then the body goes through the same gates, commit and rebuild as POST /api/apply. Section apps. Audited.

POST /api/edge/manage.note: The owner's switch that lets a company edge manage LosOS Cloud, LosOS Git and the apps (backend/src/edge.rs, management). On binds it to the edge the box uses now, which must be on the LAN and not official (409 with notManageable:true otherwise); off forgets it. lososd publishes /run/losos/edge-managed for the announce unit's heartbeat. The edge's calls arrive through the box's own tunnel at nginx's losos-manage.invalid server, with X-Losos-Via-Edge and the box's proxy token in X-Losos-Edge, and lososd lets them through only while that edge is the one in use; they reach the sections backend/sections.json lists under `edge` and GETs of signed-in routes, never an admin route. Admin. Audited.

POST /api/edge/cluster.note: The owner moves the box to another secondary cluster in reach (backend/src/edge.rs, choose_path), or with null lets it settle anew. Kept in $LOSOS_STATE_DIR/edge-cluster. The path is chosen again from the last scan at once and the tunnel units follow; the mesh join runs again against the new cluster. 400 for a name that is not a DNS label or a gateway's host, 409 when no gateway of that cluster answered the last scan, and 409 `{"error":"...","heldByDomain":true}` while a live custom domain holds the box to its edge (`held`). Admin.

GET /api/options.note: Every losos.* option with its editor kind and what overrides.nix sets; the Advanced pane is drawn from it. A box without the document answers 200 with available:false, deliberately not 404, which the SPA latches.

POST /api/config/sync.note: One sync with LosOS Git now, then the same document as the read. Audited: it can push, fast-forward /etc/nixos and queue a rebuild.

dbus.name: org.losos1
dbus.note: lososd (systemd system service, root) owns the well-known name. Authorization: shipped system-bus policy — root always, group 'losos' otherwise. Every method returns a single string 's' carrying the JSON document of the same-named facade subcommand; Change/Apply additionally take their payload as the single input string. Error replies use error name org.losos1.Error.Failed with the message as the first body string.
